import requests

url = "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug_view/data/compound/25436/JSON"
r = requests.get(url)
data = r.json()

def find_synonyms(d):
    # Search for synonyms in pug_view
    for sec in d.get('Record', {}).get('Section', []):
        if sec.get('TOCHeading') == 'Names and Identifiers':
            for ssec in sec.get('Section', []):
                if ssec.get('TOCHeading') == 'Synonyms':
                    for sssec in ssec.get('Section', []):
                        print(sssec.get('TOCHeading'))
                        for info in sssec.get('Information', []):
                            print("Name:", info.get('Name'))
                            print("Value:", info.get('Value', {}).get('StringWithMarkup', [])[:5])

find_synonyms(data)
print("Record Title:", data.get('Record', {}).get('RecordTitle'))

# Let's check the synonyms and their sources in PubChem

# Or check the SID linked to CID 25436

r = requests.get(url_sids)
sids = r.json().get('InformationList', {}).get('Information', [{}])[0].get('SID', [])
print(f"Total SIDs: {len(sids)}, SIDs: {sids}")

for sid in sids:
    sid_url = f"https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/substance/sid/{sid}/summary/JSON"

    source_name = res.get('SourceSummary', {}).get('SourceName')
    substance_name = res.get('Substance', {}).get('SynonymList')
